pairs.ask: UpKeep Command Center: Members tile, what leads the Members agent tile.

optionA.label: Messages first
optionA.desc: Open member messages lead, first visit week in a fold.

optionB.label: First visit week first
optionB.desc: The first visit week leads, messages move down.

pairs.ask: UpKeep Command Center: Technicians tile, how the first week's routes are laid out.

optionA.label: Grouped by tech dash
optionA.desc: One list, a heading per tech dash, two stops each.

optionB.label: Three tech dash columns
optionB.desc: Each tech dash in its own column, side by side.

pairs.ask: UpKeep Command Center: Tools and Equipment tile, how vans below minimum are shown.

optionA.label: Bars plus the short list
optionA.desc: A bar per van and the low lines listed below.

optionB.label: Bars only
optionB.desc: Thicker bars per van; tap a bar for the lines.

pairs.ask: UpKeep Command Center: Scheduling week, how each day's load shows in the week strip.

optionA.label: Dots per tech dash
optionA.desc: Small dots fill per tech dash up to four stops a day.

optionB.label: Big day numbers
optionB.desc: One large number per day, no dots.

pairs.ask: UpKeep Command Center: Alerts style, how alerts read in Ethan's strip.

optionA.label: Tag chips
optionA.desc: Each alert ends in a small coloured tag: Urgent, Safety flag.

optionB.label: Thin terracotta edge
optionB.desc: A soft tinted row with a terracotta edge, no tags.

pairs.ask: UpKeep Command Center: Fold downs, whether the longer lists start closed or open.

optionA.label: Closed with a summary
optionA.desc: Each fold shows a one-line summary until tapped.

optionB.label: Top folds open
optionB.desc: The busiest folds start open; longer tile.

pairs.ask: UpKeep Command Center: Open full board link, how each tile links to its full board.

optionA.label: Small link top right
optionA.desc: A quiet text link beside the tile title.

optionB.label: Button at the bottom
optionB.desc: A full-width rounded button under the tile.

pairs.ask: UpKeep Command Center: Shine level, how much light plays on the tiles.

optionA.label: Subtle shine
optionA.desc: A faint top-edge highlight and a slow, soft sheen.

optionB.label: Brighter shine
optionB.desc: A stronger edge line, warmer glow and brighter sheen.

pairs.ask: UpKeep Command Center: Needs Max box, the colour of the box holding what waits on Max.

optionA.label: Lagoon blue box
optionA.desc: Calm blue edge and tint, like the other info boxes.

optionB.label: Terracotta box
optionB.desc: Warm terracotta edge and tint so it stands out.

pairs.ask: UpKeep Command Center: Filters, how the filter buttons above a list look.

optionA.label: Pill chips
optionA.desc: Rounded chips with counts; the chosen one goes dark.

optionB.label: Underlined tabs
optionB.desc: Plain words with a lagoon underline on the chosen one.
